testcase.name: remote bytes remain quarantined and non-executable before approval
install hooks, dynamic evaluation, and self-approval claims block approval
path traversal, absolute paths, and portable name collisions fail closed
symlinks are inventoried without following them and remain critical
a failed signature is independently critical and cannot be approved
script-shaped files are inventoried and require process permission even without an executable bit
remote signature metadata is only a claim; review must attest a status explicitly
copied and foreign candidates or scans cannot gain local approval
a review must bind the exact source, revision, content hash, and inferred permissions
name collisions remain visible and cannot receive passing conformance
Proxy and accessor-bearing hostile records are rejected without invoking getters
SkillLockfile pins exact source, revision, hash, license, permissions, and approvers
lock hashing is deterministic across review, permission, and approver input order
serialized lockfiles can be integrity-checked but do not acquire runtime authority
rejected decisions remain locked as rejected and cannot be installed
disabled installation requires the exact approved content hash
passing conformance cannot report permissions outside the lockfile
activation cannot request a locked permission absent from conformance observations
activation requires exact policy, passing conformance, and a non-expanding scope
activation artifacts cannot be mixed across independent vault boundaries
non-canonical or accessor-bearing lock snapshots fail closed
